menu.race_selection.title: CHOOSE YOUR RACE
menu.race_selection.subtitle: Select your character's race to begin the journey
menu.race.human.desc: Adaptable, ambitious, and resilient across every frontier. Humans excel at mastering new skills and thriving in any climate.
menu.race.elf.desc: Swift, keen-eyed, and deeply attuned to ancient forests and subterranean caverns alike. Elves favor agility and precision.
menu.race.dwarf.desc: Stout, hardy, and unmatched beneath the stone. Dwarves possess iron endurance, keen cavern sight, and unrivaled mining craft.
menu.subrace.nordling.desc: Hardy folk of the northern highlands. Accustomed to bitter winters and rugged trails, Northern Humans boast higher vitality and steady endurance.
menu.subrace.nordling.trait1.name: Frost-Hardened
menu.subrace.nordling.trait1.desc: +10 Max Health, +10 Max Stamina, and natural cold resilience.
menu.subrace.nordling.trait2.name: Iron Discipline
menu.subrace.nordling.trait2.desc: +5% XP gain across all skill trees and +1 base Defense.
menu.subrace.sunlander.desc: Quick-footed travelers of sunlit savannas and eastern steppes. Southern Humans learn swiftly and move with effortless grace.
menu.subrace.sunlander.trait1.name: Quick Learner
menu.subrace.sunlander.trait1.desc: +12% XP gain across all skill trees and faster mastery.
menu.subrace.sunlander.trait2.name: Steppe Stride
menu.subrace.sunlander.trait2.desc: +4% base movement speed and natural heat resilience.
menu.subrace.wood_elf.desc: Fleet-footed guardians of ancient canopies. Wood Elves outpace every rival across wild terrain with deep stamina reserves.
menu.subrace.wood_elf.trait1.name: Canopy Stride
menu.subrace.wood_elf.trait1.desc: +10% base movement speed and +15 Max Stamina.
menu.subrace.wood_elf.trait2.name: Wilderness Kin
menu.subrace.wood_elf.trait2.desc: Enhanced foraging instinct and +15% dusk & cavern sight.
menu.subrace.dark_elf.desc: Born in luminous crystal caverns far beneath the surface. Dark Elves pierce pitch-black tunnels with unmatched subterranean vision.
menu.subrace.dark_elf.trait1.name: Underdark Sight
menu.subrace.dark_elf.trait1.desc: +85% Cave Vision bonus for navigating deep caverns.
menu.subrace.dark_elf.trait2.name: Shadow Step
menu.subrace.dark_elf.trait2.desc: +7% base movement speed and +5% mining precision.
menu.subrace.mountain_dwarf.desc: Forged in high granite strongholds. Mountain Dwarves endure punishing blows while swinging pickaxes and hammers with tireless power.
menu.subrace.mountain_dwarf.trait1.name: Granite Bulwark
menu.subrace.mountain_dwarf.trait1.desc: +25 Max Health and +4 base Defense against heavy blows.
menu.subrace.mountain_dwarf.trait2.name: Anvil Born
menu.subrace.deep_dwarf.desc: Delvers of basalt abysses and magma-lit geodes. Deep Dwarves carve through the hardest bedrock faster than any other folk.
menu.subrace.deep_dwarf.trait1.name: Master Delver
menu.subrace.deep_dwarf.trait1.desc: +25% Mining Speed and bonus ore recovery in deep strata.
menu.subrace.deep_dwarf.trait2.name: Obsidian Sight
menu.subrace.deep_dwarf.trait2.desc: +65% Cave Vision and +20 Max Health with heat resilience.
menu.subrace.coastal_human.desc: Bold seafarers of stormy archipelagos and bustling port cities. Coastal Humans swim swiftly, endure deep dives, and thrive across oceans and rivers.
menu.subrace.coastal_human.trait1.name: Sea-Born
menu.subrace.coastal_human.trait1.desc: +30% Swim Speed and extended underwater breath capacity.
menu.subrace.coastal_human.trait2.name: Navigator's Eye
menu.subrace.coastal_human.trait2.desc: +8% XP gain, balanced climate resilience, and fortune in exploration.
menu.subrace.high_elf.desc: Scholars of lofty citadels and starlit spires. High Elves unite lethal precision, extended reach, and deep arcane attunement.
menu.subrace.high_elf.trait1.name: Astral Blood
menu.subrace.high_elf.trait1.desc: +10% XP gain, +25% Cave Vision, and innate arcane affinity.
menu.subrace.high_elf.trait2.name: Lofty Focus
menu.subrace.high_elf.trait2.desc: +0.25 block reach, razor precision, and a 2-block elven leap.
menu.subrace.hill_dwarf.desc: Prosperous smiths, merchants, and brewers of green slopes and rocky valleys. Hill Dwarves excel in surface craft, endurance, and rich harvests.
menu.subrace.hill_dwarf.trait1.name: Master Craftsman
menu.subrace.hill_dwarf.trait1.desc: +12% Mining Speed, +6% XP gain, and superior forged item durability.
menu.subrace.hill_dwarf.trait2.name: Bounty of the Hills
menu.subrace.hill_dwarf.trait2.desc: +20 Max Health, +10 Stamina, and longer-lasting food and tonic effects.

menu.loading.title: LOADING WORLD...
menu.loading.tip_1: Tip: Legend has it that deep caverns hide shimmering amethyst geodes and rare crystals.
menu.loading.tip_2: Tip: Beware of digging straight down. You never know where stone ends and lava begins.
menu.loading.tip_3: Tip: Winds and storms shift with time. Rainy days leave the wilderness lush and vibrant.
menu.loading.tip_4: Tip: Trees and wild flora thrive in harmony alongside small streams and rolling hills.
menu.loading.tip_5: Tip: The procedural horizon stretches for miles. Take a moment to watch the sunset sky.
menu.loading.tip_6: Tip: If you ever lose your way, build a tall pillar of blocks to serve as a makeshift beacon.
menu.loading.tip_7: Tip: Every block has its own unique acoustic resonance when broken or placed upon the ground.
menu.loading.tip_8: Tip: Nights can be peaceful and serene, ideal for watching the moon while enjoying the soundtrack.
menu.loading.tip_9: Tip: You can sculpt blocks into varied shapes and slopes for intricate architectural detail.
menu.loading.tip_10: Tip: No voxels were harmed during the procedural generation of this world.
